checks.expectation: Every table count matches manifest.json
checks.name: Manifest row counts

checks.expectation: Zero duplicate primary keys
checks.name: Primary-key uniqueness

checks.expectation: Every user_id resolves to observed/users
checks.name: User foreign keys

checks.expectation: One matching chosen candidate and declared candidate count per decision
checks.name: Choice/candidate consistency

checks.expectation: No latent, utility, episode, or true-coordinate columns in observed tables
checks.name: Observed/truth boundary

checks.expectation: All observed events fall inside the simulated interval
checks.name: Event time window

checks.expectation: All observed points fall in a broad Kanto bounding box with positive accuracy
checks.name: Coordinate plausibility

checks.expectation: At least 99% of users have distinct home coordinates
checks.name: Continuous home geography

checks.expectation: At least 10% of sampled users are within 5 km of a user assigned to another hub catchment
checks.name: Cross-region spatial overlap

checks.expectation: At least 99% of passive events match a true stop within 15 minutes
checks.name: Passive-to-trajectory matching

checks.expectation: Matched passive events retain the true region label
checks.name: Passive region consistency

checks.expectation: Median passive displacement is nonzero and plausible for configured synthetic noise
checks.name: GPS noise is present

checks.expectation: Chosen POIs are nearer on average than the candidate pool
checks.name: Choice responds to distance

checks.expectation: Chosen POIs are more often exposed than candidates overall
checks.name: Choice responds to exposure

checks.expectation: Chosen alternatives have higher mean total utility
checks.name: Choice responds to utility

checks.expectation: Recorded stochastic residual is non-negative for every candidate
checks.name: Utility decomposition

checks.expectation: Digital engagement positively correlates with recorded event volume
checks.name: Non-random observability

checks.expectation: All five intended episode types appear
checks.name: Episode coverage

checks.expectation: At least half of users have observations in two or more services
checks.name: Cross-service cohort

checks.expectation: At least 100 travel events in the pilot; still treat this as a sparse probe
checks.name: Travel signal volume
